description: This file defines the CustomValueDescriptor interface, which specifies methods for describing how custom values are stored in the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for retrieving class names and configuration parameters related to custom datatypes and handlers.

classes.name: CustomValueDescriptor
classes.description: Interface for describing storage details of custom value types, including datatype class, configuration, preferred handler class, and handler configuration.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Returns the classname of the CustomDatatype implementation used to store this custom value.

methods.name: getDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration string to be used with the CustomDatatype, such as regex patterns for validation.

methods.name: getPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Returns the classname of the preferred CustomDatatypeHandler for this custom value type, or null if not specified.

methods.name: getHandlerConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration string for the handler, such as specific validation or formatting parameters.
